_comment: Whole-repo crate/module decomposition - the target architecture of the Rust
port. Target-agnostic and cumulative: 'which unique Rust .rs does this C
symbol/type live in', independent of porting progress. Port/wrap status and
per-target scope live in scope.json, never here. Two layers seeded at
different times: CRATES (one per link unit, mirroring build.json's
`libraries` keys) and, within each, MODULES + their .rs files,
whose `members` CrustifyScaffolder fills as entities are brought in scope.
`crustify scaffold` is a mechanical lookup against this file.
_comment_placement: Every symbol/type is attributed to EXACTLY ONE .rs, in two mechanical steps.
(1) Assign the entity to a MODULE (the subsystem it belongs to, see modules) -
reasoned from its `query` record (`defined_in` / `declared_in`), the codebase,
and build.json (NOT build.info, a per-target artifact some targets lack).
Normally every entity from one C source file shares a module. (2) Home it in
`<source-stem>.rs` within that module: take its `defined_in`, drop the
directory, swap the extension for .rs - a TU (`bn_lib.c` -> `bn_lib.rs`) and a
header (`bn_local.h` -> `bn_local.rs`) are treated IDENTICALLY. Entities that
share a `defined_in` co-home. Entities with `defined_in: null` (callbacks,
externs, opaque/forward-declared structs) have no source file: place each in
the module and `<header>.rs` of the best-fit `declared_in` header. Lookup key:
(name, def_file) OR (name, decl_file) for null-def_file entities.
_comment_crate: crates: one entry per link unit, keyed by crate name. `kind` is the crate
type (library -> staticlib/cdylib, executable -> bin). `in_tree` is false for
external deps we only bind (libc): their entities carry a null def_file.
`sys_crate` (the FFI/wrap companion) is present only for in_tree libraries.
`depends_on` is the inter-crate edge set from build.json link_dependencies -
a DAG; the SCC floor forbids a cycle between two crates. `modules` is {} in a
_comment_module: modules: logical subsystems within a crate, keyed by module name. `rust_path`
is the module dir under crate_path. `rs` maps each Rust file to the C source
file it mirrors and is the single source of truth - the module's source-file
and header surface are NOT stored, they are DERIVED on demand from the `rs`
entries: the module's source files are the distinct `def_file`s (`.c` TUs and
`.h` headers alike); its boundary headers are the union of the `decl_files`,
zoned by path -> Rust visibility (`*_local.h` -> pub(crate); `include/internal/*`
-> pub to sibling crates; `include/openssl/*` -> published API).
_comment_rs: rs: keyed by the .rs path under crate_path. Each entry mirrors ONE C source
file - `def_file` is that file: a `.c` for a TU-homed set, a `.h` for a
header-homed set, or null only for an external/system entity set (libc,
placed by `decl_files`). `decl_files` are the headers the members are declared
through. `members` lists the entities homed here by kind (functions / types /
macros / globals) as BARE NAMES - provenance lives once on the .rs, not per
member. Every entity whose `defined_in` is this file homes here; a null-def
entity homes here when this is the `<header>.rs` of its best-fit `declared_in`.

src/statem/statem_lib.rs._comment: TU-homed: the functions/globals defined in statem_lib.c.

src/statem/statem_local.rs._comment: header-homed: a type DEFINED in statem_local.h mirrors statem_local.rs - NOT bound to a consuming/implementing TU.

src/comp/comp.rs._comment: stack_st_SSL_COMP is a phantom (null def_file); placed by its best-fit declared_in header (comp.h), homing in comp.rs alongside comp.h's own defined entities.

libc._comment: external dep: in_tree=false. Its entities are externs (null def_file) placed by decl_files; def_file stays null (no in-tree source to mirror). bindgen-only, never ported; no sys_crate.
